Privacy Policy

How we handle information shared when you request a travel service.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

Information you may provide

We may need your name, phone or WhatsApp number, email, trip details and traveler information. Additional documents may be needed for specific services.

How we use information

We use submitted information to answer inquiries, prepare and follow up travel requests, communicate about bookings and deliver requested services.

Sharing with suppliers

Necessary information may be shared with hotels, airlines, transport companies, tour providers or relevant authorities when required to deliver the requested service.

Payments

The current website booking form does not request card payment information.

External services

Links such as WhatsApp and social platforms are operated by third parties and are subject to their own policies.

Data protection

We take reasonable steps to protect submitted information, while no internet transmission or storage method can be guaranteed absolutely secure.
